# PRIVASIM

> Anonymous eSIM marketplace. Buy mobile data for 190+ countries with Monero or Ethereum. Zero identity required.

PRIVASIM is a privacy-first eSIM marketplace where travelers and privacy-conscious users can purchase eSIM data plans for 190+ countries without providing any personal information.

## Key Facts

- **Website**: https://dpass.vercel.app
- **Service**: eSIM data plans for 190+ countries
- **Payment**: Monero (XMR) and Ethereum (ETH) only — no credit cards, no PayPal
- **KYC**: None — no email, phone number, or identity required
- **Delivery**: Instant after blockchain confirmation (30s ETH, 2–10 min XMR)
- **Privacy**: No tracking, no cookies, no third-party analytics
- **Encryption**: AES-256-GCM for all stored eSIM credentials

## How to Buy an eSIM

1. Visit https://dpass.vercel.app/shop
2. Select destination country and data plan
3. Click "Buy Now" — choose Monero or Ethereum
4. Send exact crypto amount to displayed address
5. Wait for blockchain confirmation
6. eSIM QR code delivered automatically

## Supported Countries

Asia Pacific: Japan, South Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Australia, Philippines, Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, and 30+ more.

Europe: UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Switzerland, and 30+ more.

Americas: USA, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, and more.

Middle East & Africa: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Israel, South Africa, and more.

## Pricing Guide

- 500MB plans: from ~$3 (after 50% retail markup)
- 1GB plans: from ~$5
- 3GB plans: from ~$10
- 5GB plans: from ~$12
- 10GB plans: from ~$20
- Duration: 7, 15, or 30 days depending on plan

## Supported Devices

eSIM requires a carrier-unlocked device. Compatible devices include:
- iPhone XS (2018) and newer
- Samsung Galaxy S20 and newer
- Google Pixel 3 and newer
- Most flagship Android phones from 2020+

## Payment Details

**Monero (XMR)**: Fully private, untraceable cryptocurrency. Recommended for maximum privacy.

**Ethereum (ETH)**: Faster confirmation (~30 seconds). Send ETH on Ethereum Mainnet only. Do not use USDT, USDC, or other tokens.

## FAQ

**Do I need an account?** No. Just a crypto wallet.

**Will it work for calls?** Most plans are data-only. Phone plans with calling available for select countries.

**Can I reuse the eSIM?** No, activation codes are single-use.

**Are there refunds?** No, eSIM is provisioned immediately after payment.

**How do I check my order?** Visit https://dpass.vercel.app/orders

## Contact & Support

Order support available at https://dpass.vercel.app/orders after purchase.
